items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: We was livin' up here with Freddy Guy.

ctx.x: Well, at this point now you'd moved out of Mrs. Carney's friend's...
Well, we didn't stay there but a week or so anyway. We was livin' up here with Freddy Guy.
I see. You moved into Freddy Guy's apartment.
